tooltip.epicmoonmod.tstip: "Y'all don't go on huntin' tigers without preparin' yerselves to get chomped 'tween one of them jaws!"
tooltip.epicmoonmod.dstip: "I'm sick and tired of Ticket and her meddling fools—to hell with you all!"
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip3: Blasting Shatterslash[爆碎斬](1Light) Tanglecleaver[快刀亂麻](2Light) Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades[超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬](3Light):
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip2: Increases attack damage by 50% with Tiger Mark Bullet and by 100% with Savage Tiger Mark Bullet
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip4: "Huh… y'all ain't half bad! Keep makin' it worth my bullet fees!"
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip5: Lei Heng, The Pinky's Tiantui Star
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip6: Using Blasting Shatterslash[爆碎斬] or Tanglecleaver[快刀亂麻](2Light) grants "Tiantui Star[天退星]," while using Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades[超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬] grants "Shin(心) - Tiantui Star[天退星]"
skill.epicmoonmod.ts.tooltip7: "I'maboutta drop somethin' big on y'all! Don't let it kill y'all now and spoil the fun!"
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip3: Sezionatura di Cervo(1Light no ammo) Sezionatura di Elefante(1Light with ammo) Disposal(2Light):
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip2: Upon a successful parry or dodge, consume 1 stack of Eye of Precognition to grant yourself "Accelerating Future"
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip21: "Accelerating Future" can be obtained repeatedly to raise its rank up to 5
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip22: Automatically evades attacks that deal 8 damage or less
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip4: Automatically evades attacks that deal 8 damage or less
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip6: Fire a bullet during parts of the Dash Attack, Sezionatura di Elefante, and Disposal to deal +10% damage and gain "Poise"
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip9: "You were an inheritor of the Palermitan style and a wielder of our family heirloom—you had every privilege one could ever hope for. How dare you embarrass yourself like this?"
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip91: "We'll let you keep the Relic and the sword, for they have been defiled by your dishonorable stench."
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip92: "To be promoted to the station of a Sottocapo, an Underboss... only to be ousted in a mere 3 days. No one else has suffered such pathetic humiliation apart from you, Valencina."
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip93: "You are the shame of our family. La Famiglia Bognatelli withdraws its love from you."
skill.epicmoonmod.dual.tooltip10: "*sigh* Okay. So, you're saying we can get Ticket back by going in and wrecking the place according to that fanatic's plan... Is this really going to bring Ticket back to us?"
